messages:
jordan: Hey team — our March invoice (INV-2026-03-1223) arrived without our PO. AP won't post the payment without PO-98765 on the invoice. Can you reissue with the PO? We already paid via card but need the updated invoice for our records.

taylor_support: Thanks for the ping, jordan. Can you confirm the billing account or billing email for that invoice? Also do you need a straight reissue or a credit+rebill so AP sees a new invoice number? (some accounting systems prefer credit notes so history is clear)

jordan: Billing email is billing@acme.example. We prefer credit+rebill so our ledger shows the correction. Please apply the payment to the new invoice if possible. Need this processed today if we can — AP holds monthly close.

(taylor_support added billing-bot)
billing-bot: New billing ticket created: FIN-7891. Invoice metadata check queued.

taylor_support: FYI tagging @anna_finance to confirm the credit + rebill workflow and whether we can automatically apply the existing payment to the new invoice.

anna_finance: Got it — I'll take this. Quick note on process: we can issue a credit note (CN-2026-03-045) and generate a new invoice with the PO field populated. Timeline 1 business day; if you need same payment applied, we can allocate the payment to the new invoice once the credit posts. Two questions: 1) confirm VAT/tax details on file, 2) confirm billing address for the reissued invoice.

jordan: VAT: EU VAT ID GB999999999. Billing address: 123 Acme Way, London, UK. Yes please apply the existing payment to the new invoice.

anna_finance: Thanks. I'm seeing why PO dropped — our ingestion pipeline didn't surface the `po_number` field from the payment metadata for card payments if the PO was entered in freeform notes. Filed a follow-up with infra to reduce recurrence.

anna_finance: Actioning now — creating credit note and rebill. Will update this thread when done. (ETA: ~2 hours)

(2 hours later)

anna_finance: Done — created credit note CN-2026-03-045 and new invoice INV-2026-03-1223-PO-98765. Payment has been applied to the new invoice and the credit note shows as settled. Links:
```
Credit note: https://billing.redwood.ai/credits/CN-2026-03-045
Invoice: https://billing.redwood.ai/invoices/INV-2026-03-1223-PO-98765
```
Please confirm that these documents meet AP requirements and that the PO is visible on the PDF/download.

jordan: Confirmed — we received the new invoice and PO is present on the PDF. AP will release the hold. Thank you!

taylor_support: Great — marking this resolved on our side. I'll keep the infra ticket open for the ingestion fix and follow up with a short postmortem. If anything else comes up, reopen the thread or email billing@redwood.ai. :white_check_mark:

anna_finance: Closing FIN-7891 after 24h QA. If AP needs a mailed/emailed copy in a different format, let us know.
